Each bubble represents a global health area, with its size indicating the number of products in scope. Use the toggle to switch between candidates in development and approved products to compare where R&D activity and market-ready solutions are most concentrated.

home.map.description: A global snapshot of R&D activity, highlighting where clinical trials are conducted and where product developers are based.

Darker shades indicate countries with a higher concentration of trials or developers, highlighting global research hubs as well as regions with limited R&D presence.

Use the filters below to focus on specific product types or R&D stage. Click items in the legend to turn individual stages on or off to compare how pipelines are distributed across the development lifecycle.

home.reports.card_2_description: Executive briefing presenting findings from three case studies demonstrating how selected global health innovations enhance health outcomes and provide economic value across the US, UK, Japan, and Europe.
home.reports.card_2_title: The Ripple Effect 2.0: from global health to domestic value
home.reports.card_3_description: The 100 Days Mission's 5th Implementation Report and Scorecard highlight limited progress has been made in an R&D ecosystem that remains reactive and reliant on US funding.

layout.header.about.description: Meet the team working to create a more equitable future through global health innovation and impact.
layout.header.about.item_advocacy_descri: Join us in creating global health impact with our advocacy and press kits.
layout.header.about.item_contact_descrip: Please get in touch with any questions or feedback. Between us, we cover most time zones so one of us will get back to you quickly.
layout.header.about.item_council_descrip: Bringing together some of the leading and most influential figures in global health, our Council challenges our thinking, expands our foresight and helps us with horizon scanning.
layout.header.about.item_join_descriptio: We build bridges, partnerships and consensus across the complex ecosystem of global health R&D players. Find out how to partner with us, commission our expertise, and how to join our team when we have vacancies.
layout.header.about.item_team_descriptio: Meet our diverse international team of experts, who collate and analyse data on global health funding and the innovation pipeline.
layout.header.data.description: Here are the gold-standard databases and data visualizations of R&D funding, approved products and candidates in the pipeline for neglected diseases, emerging infectious diseases and maternal health.
layout.header.data.item_gfinder_descript: Since 2007, the G-FINDER project tracks R&D funding for new products and technologies across global health areas.
layout.header.data.item_pipeline_descrip: Our product pipeline portal provides an overview of health products approved or in development across global health areas.
layout.header.data.item_spillover_descri: A tracker of health innovations developed for LMICs that have translated into new applications and benefits in HICs.
layout.header.insights.description: Here you will find the analysis and insights to support decisions - whether you're funding research, setting policies, developing products or advocating for change.
layout.header.insights.item_dialogues_de: A series of dialogues with global health leaders to co-create an R&D investment roadmap that is fit for the future.
layout.header.insights.item_health_areas: This quick reference guide gives you a snapshot analysis of the R&D needs and the state of innovation to tackle each disease or condition we cover. It's a handy quick overview of what's needed to impact global health in these areas.
layout.header.insights.item_hub_impact_d: Global, UK and EU analyses of the health and economic impact of the last two decades of investment in global health R&D.
layout.header.insights.item_hub_impact_l: The Impact of Global Health R&D Hub
layout.header.insights.item_hub_investme: A unique source of data and analysis tracking the funding of global health R&D and the pipeline of products in development. Powered by G-FINDER.
layout.header.insights.item_hubs_descrip: Themed collections of all the data, analysis and tools you need to understand the landscape and make smart decisions on global health R&D.
layout.header.insights.item_reports_desc: Our reports deliver critical insights using the evidence collected through G-FINDER and over two decades of independent analysis.
layout.header.insights.item_womens_hub_d: This resource hub provides a suite of data, insights and tools to accelerate progress in women's health R&D.
layout.header.tools.description: We've created some practical frameworks and tools you can use to assess and increase impact in global health.
layout.header.tools.featured_description: Join us in creating global health impact with our advocacy and press kits
layout.header.tools.item_100days_descrip: Is the world ready to deploy a new product to tackle an epidemic within 100 days of an outbreak?
layout.header.tools.item_framework_descr: A global network of experts collaborated for two years to develop this comprehensive set of metrics that create an impact assessment framework for global health R&D.

pipeline_explorer.approved.approval_stat: This chart shows the total number of approved products by approval status. Each bar represents a specific approval status, enabling quick comparison across statuses.
pipeline_explorer.approved.approving_aut: The chart compares the number of approved products by approving authorities, and the number of those products with WHO prequalification.
pipeline_explorer.approved.intro: Three summary charts cover approval status, approving authorities and WHO prequalification. A searchable table below lists every approved product matching the page-level filters.
pipeline_explorer.approved.table_descrip: A row-by-row view of every approved product matching the page-level filters. Use the per-column filters below each header to narrow further, then export the matching rows to .csv.
pipeline_explorer.approved.who_prequal_d: A comparison of approved products that have a WHO prequalification. The WHO prequalification is a 'gold standard' for products intended for use in low- and middle-income countries.
pipeline_explorer.candidates.table_descr: A matrix of candidates scoped by the page-level filters, with per-column filters below each header to narrow further. Each row gives candidate-level detail: name, R&D stage, developer, indication and more.
pipeline_explorer.kpi.approved_emerging: The number of those approved products addressing emerging infectious diseases.
pipeline_explorer.kpi.approved_neglected: The number of those approved products addressing neglected diseases.
pipeline_explorer.kpi.approved_total: The number of approved health products that match the current filters.

pipeline_explorer.kpi.candidates_neglect: The number of those candidates addressing neglected diseases.

pipeline_explorer.kpi.trials_neglected_d: The number of those trials addressing neglected diseases.

pipeline_explorer.kpi.trials_womens_heal: The number of those trials addressing women's health conditions.
pipeline_explorer.page.table_builder_int: Build custom tables of candidates, approved products, clinical trials and R&D priorities, then export as CSV. Page-level filters stay applied across the Visual Insights view and Table Builder. Use Share this view to copy a link with your filters preserved. On every table you can sort by any column and use the Columns button (top right) to show, hide or reorder columns.
pipeline_explorer.page.title: Pipeline Explorer
pipeline_explorer.page.visual_insights_i:
Pipeline Explorer offers two complementary views of the pipeline. The visual insights view presents interactive charts across candidates, approved products, clinical trials and technology types; switch to the table builder view to assemble a custom dataset and export it as .csv.

Page-level filters stay applied as you move across the tabs or to the table builder. Use Share this view to copy a link with your filters preserved. On every table you can sort by any column, use the Columns button (top right) to show, hide or reorder columns, and follow the Explore → link on any row to open the full record for that entity.

pipeline_explorer.tech.coverage_descript: How the selected technology type covers individual diseases, split by global health area. Select a bar to see the candidates and approved products for that disease.
pipeline_explorer.tech.coverage_empty: Select a technology type from the bar chart above to see disease coverage.
pipeline_explorer.tech.section_descripti: Each card shows a product type with its total candidate count and technology count. Select a card to see how that product type breaks down by technology and R&D stage in the chart below.
pipeline_explorer.tech.vcp_select_prompt: Select a category to explore its technology breakdown

pipeline_explorer.trials.age_groups_desc: Proportion of clinical trial participants in each age bracket, highlighting which age groups are most and least represented across the portfolio.
pipeline_explorer.trials.geo_description: The global heat map shows the country-level distribution of clinical trials, with darker shades indicating countries with higher numbers of studies, and can be filtered by clinical trial status.
pipeline_explorer.trials.intro: The clinical-trial layer of the pipeline — who is being studied, where, and at what stage. Two charts, a map and a searchable table cover age group, status, geography and trial-level detail.
pipeline_explorer.trials.table_descripti: The clinical trial table is a matrix of individual studies, providing granular details such as title, clinical trial status, location, start date, URL and more. Use the per-column filters below each header to narrow results, then export the matching rows to .csv.
pipeline_explorer.trials.trial_status_de: Number of studies at each stage across the portfolio, from ongoing to completed.
pipeline_overview.chart.description: Each horizontal bar shows a product type, with colour-coded segments for how many candidates and approved products sit at each R&D stage. Use the page-level filters to narrow the view, click items in the legend to toggle stages on or off, or use Export Visual to save the chart as an image.
pipeline_overview.chart.title: Global pipeline overview

pipeline_overview.page.intro: An interactive overview of the global health R&D pipeline by global health area, disease, product type and R&D stage. Page-level filters scope every chart here. Use Share this view to copy a link with your filters preserved.
pipeline_overview.page.title: Pipeline overview
pipeline_overview.product_types.descript: A snapshot of how the R&D pipeline is distributed across product types. Click on the drop-down to toggle between candidates, approved products or both. Use the ··· menu to export the chart as an image or the underlying data as .csv.
pipeline_overview.product_types.title: Product types
pipeline_trends.gfinder.body_left: G-FINDER is the gold-standard tracker of R&D funding for new products and technologies for global health. Updated annually, this is the evidence base informing all global health advocacy, investment and policy change.
pipeline_trends.gfinder.body_right:
**The case for change:** Explore funding trends over time, where there is innovation and where there are gaps.

**Drivers of impact:** Understand which initiatives are gaining strength and where there are weaknesses in global health R&D impact.
pipeline_trends.gfinder.heading: Tracking global health investments: discover G-FINDER's impact
pipeline_trends.page.intro: Explore how the global health R&D pipeline evolves over time across global health areas, diseases and product types. Track changes by R&D stage across specific IGH review years, and build custom comparisons by selecting one or more portfolios for deeper temporal analysis. Filters apply across the whole portal — any filter you set stays active here and on every other page until you clear it, from the global filter menu at the top or the active-filter box at the lower left.
pipeline_trends.page.title: Pipeline trends
pipeline_trends.section.description: Explore the temporal trends in the global health R&D pipeline, tracking how distributions across R&D stages shift over time by global health area, disease, and product, with filters and legend controls to refine the analysis.
pipeline_trends.section.title: Pipeline trends
pipeline_trends.temporal.compare.aggrega: Explore the temporal trends for each selected portfolio with R&D stages aggregated into early development, late development, and approved products across IGH review years.
Temporal trends in aggregated R&D stages across portfolios
pipeline_trends.temporal.compare.compari: Explore the underlying data for the selected portfolios by aggregated R&D stage in the chosen year, enabling detailed comparison of portfolio compositions.
pipeline_trends.temporal.compare.empty_p: Select portfolios and click Apply to see comparison data.
Select portfolios and apply to see comparison data.
Select portfolios and click Apply to see temporal trends.
pipeline_trends.temporal.compare.intro: Compare up to four portfolios—each defined by a specific combination of disease and product. Examine how their R&D stage distributions differ in a selected year, review the underlying data in table form, and explore temporal trends for each portfolio over time using aggregated R&D stages to identify contrasts in growth and progression.
pipeline_trends.temporal.compare.portfol: Compare up to four portfolios, each defined by a specific combination of disease and product. Examine how their R&D stage distributions differ in a selected year, review the underlying data in table form, and explore temporal trends for each portfolio. Use aggregated R&D stages to identify contrasts in growth and progression.
Portfolio comparison by R&D stage in selected year
pipeline_trends.temporal.section.descrip: Explore how selected portfolios evolve over time in the global health R&D pipeline. Analyse the temporal progression of a single portfolio, by one or more diseases and products, or compare up to four portfolios side by side to identify differences in stage distribution and trajectory.
pipeline_trends.temporal.section.title: Temporal trends & portfolio comparison
pipeline_trends.temporal.single.aggregat: Explore the temporal trends in a single portfolio with R&D stages aggregated into early development, late development, and approved products. Each cluster represents an aggregated R&D stage across IGH review years, showing how the portfolio shifts over time at a higher level than the granular stage view above.
Temporal trends in aggregated R&D stages
Explore the underlying data for aggregated R&D stages, including year-on-year changes and total growth in portfolio composition over time.

pipeline_trends.temporal.single.granular: Explore the temporal trends in a single portfolio, showing how distributions across R&D stages change over time. Filter by disease and product, and use the R&D stage legend and year controls to include or exclude specific stages and IGH review years for more focused analysis.
Temporal trends in portfolio composition across R&D stages
pipeline_trends.temporal.tab.single: Compare a single portfolio over time
table_builder.candidates_approved.descri: Candidates and approved products in a single table — useful for comparing the pipeline of in-development assets against what has already reached market. Filter by global health area, disease, product type or R&D stage, then sort and choose columns to fit the question at hand.
table_builder.candidates_approved.title: Candidates & approved products
table_builder.clinical_trials.descriptio: Clinical trials joined to the candidates they study — useful for tracing trial activity back to specific assets in the pipeline. Filter by global health area, disease or product type, then choose columns for trial-level detail.
table_builder.clinical_trials.title: Clinical trials & candidates
table_builder.empty_state.no_results_des: No rows match the active filters. Clear them to see more.
table_builder.rd_only.description: R&D priorities on their own, no candidate join — useful for understanding the priority landscape itself: author, publication date, target population, efficacy and safety expectations, source. Filter by global health area or disease, then choose columns to focus on what matters.
table_builder.rd_only.title: R&D priorities
table_builder.rd_priorities.description: R&D priorities joined to the candidates that address them — useful for seeing which priorities are well covered and which remain open. Filter by global health area or disease, then choose columns to compare priority detail against candidate progress.
table_builder.rd_priorities.title: R&D priorities & candidates
who_priority.individual.candidates_descr: A matrix of the candidates linked to the selected priority, with per-column filters beneath each header to narrow further. Sort by any column, use the Columns button to show, hide or reorder columns, follow the Explore → link on any row to open that candidate's full record, or export the matching rows to .csv.
who_priority.individual.description: Focus on a single WHO priority. Select a priority to see the pipeline mapped to it — the candidates working towards that priority, its target population, and how that pipeline builds up by R&D stage. Click Explore selected priority to open its full detail, including a link to the source.
who_priority.individual.dropdown_no_prio: No priorities match the current filters
who_priority.individual.empty_descriptio: Please select filters you'd like to include in the overview
who_priority.individual.pipeline_chart_d: How the pipeline for the selected priority builds up across R&D stages. Each bar shows a product type, segmented by the candidates at each stage; click items in the legend to toggle stages on or off, or use the ··· menu to export the chart or its data.
who_priority.individual.stat_candidates_: Number of candidates linked to selected priority

who_priority.individual.title: Individual priority analysis
who_priority.overview.description: An overview of the WHO priorities across the whole portfolio — how many are in scope, how the pipeline addressing them is distributed across product types, and the share of priorities dedicated to neglected diseases, emerging infectious diseases and women's or children's health.
who_priority.overview.product_types_desc: A snapshot of how the R&D pipeline is distributed across product types. Use the ··· menu to export the chart as an image or the underlying data as .csv.
who_priority.overview.title: Priorities overview
who_priority.overview.women_children_des: How priorities split between those dedicated to women or children (Yes), those that are not (No), and those still awaiting classification (NA). Use the ··· menu to export the chart or its data.
who_priority.overview.women_children_tit: Share of priorities dedicated to women or children
who_priority.page.intro: The WHO product-development priorities for the diseases this portal covers, with the R&D pipeline mapped against each one. Use the filters to scope the page by global health area, disease or product type.
who_priority.page.title: WHO Priority alignment
